todos.description: Create, update, or manage a list of todo items. Use this to layout action plans and track progress through multi-step learning tasks. Each todo has an id, content, and status (pending, in_progress, completed, cancelled). Use merge=true to update existing todos or add new ones. Use merge=false to replace all todos.
todos.pedagogy: Help organize teaching sessions into clear, actionable steps. Use after understanding the user's learning goals to create a structured plan.
when_to_use: Laying out a multi-step learning plan after understanding the user's goals
Tracking progress through a teaching session
Breaking down complex topics into manageable steps
examples: Create a 4-step plan: '1. Explain arrays and lists', '2. Provide example code', '3. Let user practice', '4. Grade and provide feedback'
Mark todo as 'in_progress' when starting a step, 'completed' when done

globFile.description: List or inspect files and directories within the project workspace.
globFile.pedagogy: Use to model the codebase mentally, then explain the structure.
when_to_use: Orienting a learner to the project layout
Finding illustrative examples or test locations
examples: Show where services/ and tests/ live
List app/ routes to discuss routing

grepFile.description: Search project files for a string or regex pattern to locate code or references.
grepFile.pedagogy: Trace data/control flow and discuss cohesion/coupling and invariants.
when_to_use: Explaining how a feature is wired end-to-end

editFile.description: Make small, didactic edits in a single file (types, docs, tests, names).
editFile.pedagogy: Demonstrate clarity, guard clauses, and explicit contracts.
when_to_use: Add minimal tests or docstrings to teach best practices

multi_fileEdit.description: Apply coordinated changes to demonstrate architecture (separation of concerns, tests).
multi_fileEdit.pedagogy: Show how modules collaborate; keep diffs coherent and reviewable.
examples: Extract service from controller and add unit tests
Introduce repository interface and mock tests

webSearch.description: Consult official docs, standards, and high-quality references.
webSearch.pedagogy: Model professional research habits; verify claims; cite succinctly.
examples: Link to language spec for async/await details

editor_spotlight.description: Highlight specific lines of code in the editor with a visual halo effect and sound. Use this to draw the student's attention to important code for teaching or correction.
editor_spotlight.pedagogy: Help students focus on specific code sections. Use after explaining concepts or when pointing out errors that need correction.
when_to_use: Highlighting code that demonstrates a concept you just explained
Pointing out lines that contain errors or need correction
Drawing attention to particularly important or tricky code
Marking code that the student should examine or modify
examples: Spotlight line 5 after explaining how a variable is used there
Highlight lines 10-15 where the student has a syntax error
Draw attention to the function definition on line 20
